message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live, real‑time data feeds. To get the current air quality index (AQI) for Los Angeles, you can check one of the following reliable sources:

| Source | How to use |
|--------|------------|
| **AirNow** (U.S. EPA) | Visit https://www.airnow.gov/, enter “Los Angeles” or your ZIP code, and view the latest AQI and pollutant breakdown. |
| **OpenAQ** | Go to https://openaq.org/, search for “Los Angeles,” and see recent measurements from nearby monitoring stations. |
| **Weather.com / AccuWeather** | Search “Los Angeles air quality” on their sites; they often display the AQI along with health recommendations. |
| **Mobile Apps** | Apps like “AirVisual,” “Plume Labs: Air Report,” or the official EPA AirNow app provide real‑time alerts and forecasts. |

If you’d like a quick snapshot of typical conditions (e.g., average AQI, common pollutants), let me know and I can provide that information.
